name: calibre
category: desktop app + content server (e-book library manager)
param_style: apsw / sqlite3 with ? positional; table/column names spliced in with str.format/f-strings from field metadata
schema_source: resources/metadata_sqlite.sql (CREATE statements the queries need, app-registered functions substituted), custom-column DDL from src/calibre/db/backend.py, resources/fts_sqlite.sql, tag_browser_news from src/calibre/library/database2.py
data_scale: scale 1: 20k books, 6k authors (~23k links), 1.5k tags (~50k links), 2k series, 400 publishers, 11 ratings, 10 languages, ~27k formats, ~30k identifiers, 15k comments, 20k annotations (two FTS5 indexes), 12k full-text rows (two FTS5 indexes), 3 custom columns
visibility_note: 26k stars; the standard e-book manager, every library is a metadata.db SQLite file, also served by the calibre content server
interest_note: The meta/meta2 views (one row per book with 9-15 correlated link-table subqueries and ordered group_concat), tag-browser views with correlated COUNT and 3-way AVG per item, nested IN DISTINCT chains, external-content FTS5 with snippet/highlight and rank ordering, json_extract filters over annotation JSON, ON CONFLICT upserts and trigger-heavy inserts.
reach_note: millions of users; default e-book manager on desktop
